build_FLAVAImageTransform: build a FLAVAImageTransform to resize, normalize, and mask image patches for encoder and codebook inputs
create_ImageMaskingGenerator: create an ImageMaskingGenerator to produce random rectangular patch masks for masked image modeling
use_TwoWayResize: use TwoWayResize to resize a PIL image to two different sizes with separate interpolation modes
use_TwoWayRandomResizedCrop: use TwoWayRandomResizedCrop to randomly crop and resize an image to two different sizes with different interpolations
run_map_pixels: run map_pixels to apply logit Laplace scaling to a float tensor for codebook input preparation
